# Books & Beyond

> Books & Beyond (booksnb.com) is a virtual accounting and auditing firm serving small and mid-sized businesses in the United States, Canada, and Australia. We pair credentialed, country-specialist accountants with AI-powered workflows to deliver faster month-end closes, cleaner books, and audit-ready output.

## Services

- **Bookkeeping**: Daily reconciliations, transaction categorization, monthly P&L and balance sheet.
- **Tax Filing**: Corporate returns, sales tax, and annual filings for US (IRS), Canada (CRA), and Australia (ATO).
- **Payroll**: End-to-end payroll processing and compliance filings for every jurisdiction.
- **Audit Support**: Audit-ready workpapers, internal controls documentation, and compliance prep.
- **CFO Advisory**: Management reporting, cash flow forecasting, and board-ready financials.

## Pricing

All plans billed monthly. Annual billing available on request.

| Plan       | USD      | CAD      | AUD      |
|------------|----------|----------|----------|
| Starter    | $199/mo  | $269/mo  | $299/mo  |
| Growth     | $399/mo  | $539/mo  | $589/mo  |
| Enterprise | Custom   | Custom   | Custom   |

- **Starter**: Up to 200 transactions/month, monthly bookkeeping, 1 tax return/yr, email support, QuickBooks or Xero integration.
- **Growth**: Everything in Starter + up to 500 transactions/month, payroll (up to 10 employees), quarterly reporting, dedicated accountant, priority support.
- **Enterprise**: Everything in Growth + unlimited transactions, CFO advisory, audit support, SLA guarantee, custom reporting, multi-entity support.

## Coverage

- **United States**: IRS-compliant bookkeeping, federal and state tax filings, payroll compliance.
- **Canada**: CRA-compliant filings, HST/GST, T2 corporate returns, payroll (CRA remittances). Software: Wave supported.
- **Australia**: ATO-registered, BAS lodgement, GST, superannuation, MYOB supported.

## About

Books & Beyond was founded on the belief that small businesses deserve the same quality of accounting that large enterprises have access to — without the enterprise price tag. Our accountants are credentialed professionals (CPAs, CAs, CPAs AU) embedded in their respective jurisdictions. AI handles the repetitive work; humans handle every judgment call.
